series.title: Watchmen
series.author: Alan Moore
series.synopsis: In an alternate 1985, the murder of a government-sponsored superhero draws his old allies into a conspiracy that questions the cost of power, the nature of heroism and the end of the world.

series.title: Berserk
altTitles: เบอร์เซิร์ก
series.author: Kentarou Miura, Studio Gaga
series.synopsis:
His name is Guts, the Black Swordsman, a feared warrior spoken of only in whispers. Bearer of a gigantic sword, an iron hand, and the scars of countless battles and tortures, his flesh is also indelibly marked with The Brand, an unholy symbol that draws the forces of darkness to him and dooms him as their sacrifice. But Guts won't take his fate lying down; he'll cut a crimson swath of carnage through the ranks of the damned—and anyone else foolish enough to oppose him! Accompanied by Puck the Elf, more an annoyance than a companion, Guts relentlessly follows a dark, bloodstained path that leads only to death...or vengeance.

(Source: Dark Horse)

Notes:

- Volumes 1-5 contain the 16 prequel chapters 0A - 0P.

- Chapter 83 was omitted from Volume 13 due to the author’s request.

- Volume 14 includes “Berserk: The Prototype”.

- Due to the author's passing, starting from Chapter 365, the manga is illustrated by Studio Gaga (Miura's assistants) and supervised by Kouji Mori (a close friend of Miura's).

series.title: The Sandman
series.author: Neil Gaiman
series.synopsis: Captured and imprisoned for a century, Dream of the Endless escapes and rebuilds his realm. His journey through gods, nightmares and mortals redefines the border between stories and reality.

series.title: One Piece
series.author: Eiichirou Oda
series.synopsis:
As a child, Monkey D. Luffy was inspired to become a pirate by listening to the tales of the buccaneer "Red-Haired" Shanks. But his life changed when Luffy accidentally ate the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit and gained the power to stretch like rubber...at the cost of never being able to swim again! Years later, still vowing to become the king of the pirates, Luffy sets out on his adventure...one guy alone in a rowboat, in search of the legendary "One Piece," said to be the greatest treasure in the world...

(Source: VIZ Media)

series.title: Saga
series.author: Brian K. Vaughan
series.synopsis: When two soldiers from opposite sides of a never-ending galactic war fall in love, they risk everything to raise their daughter in safety while bounty hunters, warlords and their own families hunt them across the galaxy.

series.title: Vagabond
series.author: Takehiko Inoue, Eiji Yoshikawa
series.synopsis:
At seventeen years of age, Miyamoto Musashi--still known by his childhood name, Shinmen Takezo--was a wild young brute just setting out along the way of the sword.

In the aftermath of the epic Battle of Sekigahara, Takezo finds himself a fugitive survivor on the losing side of the war. Takezo's vicious nature has made him an outcast even in his own village, and he is hunted down like an animal. At this crucial crossroads in Takezo's life, an eccentric monk and a childhood friend are the only ones who can help him find his way.

(Source: VIZ Media)

series.title: Batman
series.author: Bob Kane
series.synopsis: After witnessing his parents’ murder, billionaire Bruce Wayne dedicates his life to protecting Gotham City as the World’s Greatest Detective, a symbol of fear for criminals and hope for its people.

series.title: Monster
series.author: Naoki Urasawa
series.synopsis:
Everyone faces uncertainty at some point in their lives. Even a brilliant surgeon like Kenzo Tenma is no exception. But there’s no way he could have known that his decision to stop chasing professional success and instead concentrate on his oath to save peoples’ lives would result in the birth of an abomination. The questions of good and evil now take on a terrifyingly real dimension.

Years later, in Germany during the tumultuous post-reunification period, middle-aged childless couples are being killed one after another. The serial killer’s identity is known. The reasons why he kills are not. Dr. Tenma sets out on a journey to find the killer’s twin sister, who may hold some clues to solving the enigma of the “Monster.”

(Source: VIZ Media)

series.title: Slam Dunk
series.author: Takehiko Inoue
series.synopsis:
Hanamichi Sakuragi's got no game with girls--none at all! It doesn't help that he's known for throwing down at a moment's notice and always coming out on top. A hopeless bruiser, he's been rejected by 50 girls in a row! All that changes when he meets the girl of his dreams, Haruko, and she's actually not afraid of him! When she introduces him to the game of basketball, his life is changed forever...

(Source: VIZ Media)

series.title: Spider-Man
series.author: Stan Lee
series.synopsis: Bitten by a radioactive spider, high-school student Peter Parker gains extraordinary abilities and learns that with great power comes great responsibility. His fight for New York takes him from street thugs to the Sinister Six.

series.title: The Beginning After The End
altTitles: The Beginning After the End (Book Version)
最強の王様、二度目の人生は何をする？
series.author: TurtleMe
series.synopsis: King Grey is a remarkable ruler with a prosperous reign, and yet opulence and success cannot bury emptiness and solitude. His time as king comes to an abrupt end, and he reincarnates as Arthur Leywin — a baby born in a world of magic and monsters. Equipped with memories of his previous life and the desire to protect the newfound warmth surrounding him, Art begins his journey of becoming a strong warrior once again.

series.title: V for Vendetta
series.author: Alan Moore
series.synopsis: In a fascist Britain of the near future, a masked anarchist known as V wages a one-man war against the state and takes a young woman under his wing as his revolution spreads.

series.title: Vinland Saga
series.author: Makoto Yukimura
series.synopsis:
As a child, Thorfinn sat at the feet of the great Leif Ericson and thrilled to wild tales of a land far to the west. But his youthful fantasies were shattered by a mercenary raid. Raised by the Vikings who murdered his father, Thorfinn became a terrifying warrior, forever seeking to kill the band's leader, Askeladd, and avenge his father. Sustaining Thorfinn through his ordeal are his pride in his family and his dreams of a fertile westward land, a land without war or slavery … the land Leif called Vinland.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Notes:

- Includes the one-shot "Sayonara ga Chikai no de" (For Our Farewell Is Near)

- Includes the one-shot "Assassin's Creed: Valhalla x Vinland Saga"

- Includes two extra chapters.

- Won the Grand Prize at the Japan Media Arts Festival in 2009.

- Winner of the 36th Kodansha Manga Award in the General category in 2012.

series.title: Fullmetal Alchemist
series.author: Hiromu Arakawa
series.synopsis:
Alchemy tore the Elric brothers’ bodies apart. Can their bond make them whole again?

In this world, alchemists are those who study and perform the art of alchemical transmutation—the science of manipulating and transforming matter. They are bounded by the Law of Equivalent Exchange: in order to gain something, one must sacrifice something of equal value.

In an alchemical ritual gone wrong, Edward Elric lost his arm and his leg, and his brother Alphonse became nothing but a soul in a suit of armor. Equipped with mechanical “auto-mail” limbs, Edward becomes a state alchemist, seeking the one thing that can restore his and his brother’s bodies...the legendary Philosopher’s Stone.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

series.title: 20th Century Boys
altTitles: 20th Century Boys - Chłopaki z dwudziestego wieku
series.author: Naoki Urasawa
series.synopsis:
Humanity, having faced extinction at the end of the 20th century, would not have entered the new millennium if it weren't for them. In 1969, during their youth, they created a symbol. In 1997, as the coming disaster slowly starts to unfold, that symbol returns. This is the story of a group of boys who try to save the world.

For Kenji, a simple convenience store manager who once dreamed of becoming a rock 'n' roll musician, a host of memories from his past come rushing back when one of his childhood friends mysteriously commits suicide. Could this new death be related to the rise of a bizarre new cult that's been implicated in several other murders and disappearances? Determined to dig deeper, Kenji reunites with some of his old buddies in the hope of learning the truth behind it all.

(Source: VIZ Media)

series.title: Daredevil
series.author: Frank Miller
series.synopsis: Blinded by radioactive waste as a boy, lawyer Matt Murdock gains radar senses and fights for Hell’s Kitchen as Daredevil, balancing the courtroom and the rooftop with a faith that will not let him quit.

series.title: Goodnight Punpun
series.author: Inio Asano
series.synopsis:
Meet Punpun Punyama. He’s an average kid in an average town.

He wants to win a Nobel Prize and save the world.

He wants the girl he has a crush on to like him back.

He wants to find some porn.

That’s what he wants, but what does he get…?

(Source: VIZ Media)

series.title: Haikyu!!
altTitles: ไฮคิว!! คู่ตบฟ้าประทาน
Haikyu!! - Chàng khổng lồ tí hon
series.author: Haruichi Furudate
series.synopsis:
Shouyou Hinata is out to prove that in volleyball you don’t need to be tall to fly!

After losing his first and last volleyball match against Tobio Kageyama, “the King of the Court,” Shouyou Hinata swears to become his rival after graduating middle school. But what happens when the guy he wants to defeat ends up being his teammate?!

(Source: VIZ Media)

Notes: 

- Winner of the 61st Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2017.

- Includes two extra chapters.

series.title: Hunter x Hunter
series.author: Yoshihiro Togashi
series.synopsis:
Gon might be a country boy, but he has high aspirations. Despite his Aunt Mito's protests, Gon decides to follow in his father's footsteps and become a legendary Hunter. The Hunter hopefuls begin their journey by storm-tossed ship, where Gon meets Leorio and Kurapika, the only other applicants who aren't devastated by bouts of seasickness.

Having survived the terrors of the high seas, Gon and his companions now have to prove their worth in a variety of tests in order to find the elusive Exam Hall. And once they get there, will they ever leave alive...?

(Source: VIZ Media)

series.title: Invincible
series.author: Robert Kirkman
series.synopsis: Mark Grayson is a normal teenager whose father is the most powerful superhero on the planet. As Mark develops powers of his own, he discovers that the legacy of Omni-Man is far darker than any comic book ever told him.

series.title: Nana
series.author: Ai Yazawa
series.artist: Ai Yazawa, Sabrina Heep, Simona Maccaroni
series.synopsis:
Nana Komatsu is a young woman who's endured an unending string of boyfriend problems. Moving to Tokyo, she's hoping to take control of her life and put all those messy misadventures behind her. She's looking for love and she's hoping to find it in the big city.

Nana Osaki, on the other hand, is cool, confident and focused. She swaggers into town and proceeds to kick down the doors to Tokyo's underground punk scene. She's got a dream and won't give up until she becomes Japan's No. 1 rock'n'roll superstar.

This is the story of two 20-year-old women who share the same name. Even though they come from completely different backgrounds, they somehow meet and become best friends. The world of Nana is a world exploding with sex, music, fashion, gossip and all-night parties.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Winner of the 48th Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shoujo Category in 2002.

series.title: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
altTitles: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活
Re: Life in a different world from zero
Re:Zero - Życie w innym świecie od zera
Re:Zero - Жизнь с нуля в альтернативном мире
Re: Zero - Bắt đầu lại ở thế giới khác
Re:Zero รีเซทชีวิต ฝ่าวิกฤตต่างโลก
Re:Zero – Começando Uma Vida em Outro Mundo
Re:Zero - Re:vivre dans un autre monde à partir de zéro
series.author: Tappei Nagatsuki
series.synopsis:
Subaru Natsuki was just trying to get to the convenience store but wound up summoned to another world. He encounters the usual things--life-threatening situations, silver haired beauties, cat fairies--you know, normal stuff. All that would be bad enough, but he's also gained the most inconvenient magical ability of all--time travel, but he's got to die to use it. How do you repay someone who saved your life when all you can do is die?

(Source: Yen Press)

series.title: Superman
series.author: Jerry Siegel
series.synopsis: The last son of Krypton grows up in Smallville as Clark Kent and becomes Metropolis’s symbol of hope — a hero powerful enough to reshape the world, and kind enough not to.

series.title: The Walking Dead
series.author: Robert Kirkman
series.synopsis: After waking from a coma into a world overrun by the dead, Rick Grimes searches for his family and discovers that the living are often more dangerous than the zombies.

series.title: A Silent Voice
altTitles: รักไร้เสียง
series.author: Yoshitoki Ooima
series.synopsis:
Based on a one-shot that won the 80th Weekly Shounen Magazine Newbie Best Mangaka Award.

Shouya is a bully. When Shouko, a girl who can't hear, enters his elementary school class, she becomes their favorite target, and Shouya and his friends goad each other into devising new tortures for her. But the children's cruelty goes too far. Shouko is forced to leave the school, and Shouya ends up shouldering all the blame. Six years later, the two meet again. Can Shouya make up for his past mistakes, or is it too late?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

series.title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War
altTitles: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensaitachi no Renai Zunousen
かぐや様は告らせたい～天才たちの恋愛頭脳戦～

輝夜姬想讓人告白~天才們的戀愛頭腦戰~
series.author: Aka Akasaka
series.synopsis:
As leaders of their prestigious academy’s student council, Kaguya and Miyuki are the elite of the elite! But it’s lonely at the top… Luckily for them, they’ve fallen in love! There’s just one problem—they both have too much pride to admit it. And so begins the daily scheming to get the object of their affection to confess their romantic feelings first… Love is a war you win by losing.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Notes: 

- The first 10 chapters were published in Monthly Miracle Jump. It switched to Weekly Young Jump starting with Ch. 11, with the chapter count being reset. This entry still includes the first 10 chapters from Miracle Jump.

- Winner of the 65th Shogakukan Manga Award for "Best General Manga" category in 2019.

series.title: Monstress
series.author: Marjorie Liu
series.synopsis: In an alternate Asia scarred by war, a teenage girl with a monstrous secret and a mysterious psychic powers is hunted by witches, gods and empires that want to use her as a weapon.

series.title: Preacher
series.author: Garth Ennis
series.synopsis: A small-town preacher merged with a supernatural entity sets out with his ex-girlfriend and an Irish vampire to find God and make him answer for the state of the world.

series.title: X-Men
series.author: Chris Claremont
series.synopsis: Mutants born with extraordinary powers are feared and hunted by the world they protect. Professor Xavier’s students fight for a future where humans and mutants can coexist.

series.title: Y: The Last Man
series.author: Brian K. Vaughan
series.synopsis: A mysterious plague kills every mammal with a Y chromosome except young escape artist Yorick Brown and his monkey. Together they cross a shattered world to find the cause and a way to restore humanity.

series.title: Dorohedoro
series.author: Q Hayashida
series.synopsis:
In a city so dismal it's known only as "the Hole," a clan of Sorcerers have been plucking people off the streets to use as guinea pigs for atrocious "experiments" in the black arts. In a dark alley, Nikaido found Caiman, a man with a reptile head and a bad case of amnesia. To undo the spell, they're hunting and killing the Sorcerers in the Hole, hoping that eventually they'll kill the right one. But when En, the head Sorcerer, gets word of a lizard-man slaughtering his people, he sends a crew of "cleaners" into the Hole, igniting a war between two worlds.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes 23 side stories titled "Extra Evil" and the side story "The Lizard Head and the Magic Whistle."

series.title: East of West
series.author: Jonathan Hickman
series.synopsis: In a fractured America ruled by seven nations, the Four Horsemen ride toward the apocalypse while Death searches for the family that was taken from him.

series.title: Hellboy
series.author: Mike Mignola
series.synopsis: Summoned by Nazis during World War II, the demon child Hellboy is raised by the Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense. He spends his life punching monsters and refusing his supposed destiny.

series.title: Omniscient Reader
altTitles: อ่านชะตาวันสิ้นโลก
series.author: Singsyong, UMI, Geomnem
series.synopsis:
Back then, Dok-Ja had no idea. He had no idea his favorite web novel 'Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse' was going to come to life, and that he would become the only person to know how the world was going to end. He also had no idea he would end up becoming the protagonist of this novel-turned-reality. Now, Dok-Ja will go on a journey to change the course of the story and save humankind once and for all.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

series.title: Scott Pilgrim
series.author: Bryan Lee O'Malley
series.synopsis: Scott Pilgrim wants to date Ramona Flowers, but first he must defeat her seven evil exes in increasingly absurd battles while keeping his band and his dignity together.

series.title: Eleceed
series.author: Jae-Ho Son
series.synopsis:
Ji-U is a kind-hearted young man who harnesses the lightning quick reflexes of a cat to secretly make the world a better place – one saved little child or foster pet at a time. Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a…um…decidedly fat old fluffy cat. Together, armed with Ji-U’s super powers and Kayden’s uber-smarts, they’re out to fight those forces who would let evil rule this world. That is, if they can stand each other long enough to get the job done.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

series.title: Fables
series.author: Bill Willingham
series.synopsis: Exiled from their homelands by a ruthless Adversary, the characters of legend live secretly in New York. Snow White and Bigby Wolf keep the peace while old stories sharpen their knives.

series.title: Fruits Basket
series.author: Natsuki Takaya
series.artist: Natsuki Takaya, James Lee, Deron Bennett, Yoohae Yang, Bowen Park
series.synopsis:
After a family tragedy turns her life upside down, plucky high schooler Tohru Honda takes matters into her own hands and moves out...into a tent! Unfortunately for her, she pitches her new home on private land belonging to the mysterious Sohma clan, and it isn't long before the owners discover her secret. But, as Tohru quickly finds out when the family offers to take her in, the Sohmas have a secret of their own--when touched by the opposite sex, they turn into the animals of the Chinese Zodiac! 

(Source: Yen Press) 

Note: Volume 9 includes the bonus chapter "Rain Shelter of Terror".

series.title: Hellblazer
series.author: Jamie Delano
series.synopsis: John Constantine is a working-class occult detective with a talent for lying, a conscience he cannot quite drown and a habit of leaving his friends in the ground.

series.title: Made in Abyss
series.author: Akihito Tsukushi
series.synopsis:
In an age when the corners of the world have been scoured for their secrets, only one place remains unexplored–a massive cave system known as the Abyss. Those who traverse its endless pits and labyrinth-like tunnels are known as Cave Raiders. A young orphan named Riko dreams of following in her mother’s footsteps as a Cave Raider, and when she meets a strange robot when exploring the Abyss, she’s one step closer to achieving her goal!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Notes:

- Includes the 5-chapter "How Are You? Somewhere" side story.

- Nominated for the 11th Manga Taishou Awards (2018).

series.title: Pluto
series.author: Naoki Urasawa, Osamu Tezuka, Makoto Tezuka, Takashi Nagasaki
series.synopsis:
In an ideal world where man and robots coexist, someone or something has destroyed the powerful Swiss robot Mont Blanc. Elsewhere a key figure in a robot rights group is murdered. The two incidents appear to be unrelated...except for one very conspicuous clue - the bodies of both victims have been fashioned into some sort of bizarre collage complete with makeshift horns placed by the victims' heads. Interpol assigns robot detective Gesicht to this most strange and complex case - and he eventually discovers that he too, as one of the seven great robots of the world, is one of the targets.

(Source: VIZ Media)

series.title: Something is Killing the Children
series.author: James Tynion IV
series.synopsis: Children are disappearing in a small town, and the ones who survive speak of a monster only they can see. A mysterious woman with a blade arrives to end it — and the truth is worse than the monster.

series.title: The Horizon
altTitles: เส้นขอบฟ้า
series.author: Ji-Hun Jeong
series.synopsis:
A world where everything has been lost. A boy and a girl alone together. A spark of hope kindled between them. All they can do is move forward. But against broken adults and devastating despair, how long will they be able to keep going...?

(Source: Yen Press)

series.title: Tokyo Ghoul
altTitles: 東京喰種 トーキョーグール
series.author: Sui Ishida
series.synopsis:
Shy Ken Kaneki is thrilled to go on a date with the beautiful Rize. But it turns out that she’s only interested in his body—eating it, that is. When a morally questionable rescue transforms him into the first half-human half-Ghoul hybrid, Ken is drawn into the dark and violent world of Ghouls, which exists alongside our own.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

series.title: Attack on Titan
series.author: Hajime Isayama
series.synopsis:
In this post-apocalyptic sci-fi story, humanity has been devastated by the bizarre, giant humanoids known as the Titans. Little is known about where they came from or why they are bent on consuming mankind. Seemingly unintelligent, they have roamed the world for years, killing everyone they see. For the past century, what's left of man has hidden in a giant, three-walled city. People believe their 50-meter-high walls will protect them from the Titans, but the sudden appearance of an immense Titan is about to change everything.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

series.title: Black Hammer
series.author: Jeff Lemire
series.synopsis: After a battle erased them from the world, a team of Golden Age superheroes wake up trapped in a small farming town. Fifteen years later, they still cannot leave — or agree on why.

series.title: Chainsaw Man
altTitles: มนุษย์เลื่อยยนต์
series.author: Tatsuki Fujimoto
series.synopsis:
The name says it all! Denji's life of poverty is changed forever when he merges with his pet chainsaw dog, Pochita! Now he's living in the big city and an official Devil Hunter. But he's got a lot to learn about his new job and chainsaw powers!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Notes:

- Nominated for the 2020 Manga Taisho Award.

- Winner of the 2021 Kono Manga ga Sugoi Award.

- Winner of the 66th Shogakukan Manga Award in the shounen category.

- Winner of the 2021 and 2022 Harvey Award for Best Manga.

- Chapters 1-97 were released in Weekly Shounen Jump from Dec 3, 2018 to Dec 13, 2020. The series resumed from Ch. 98 in Shounen Jump+ on July 12, 2022

series.title: Death Note
series.author: Tsugumi Ooba
series.artist: Takeshi Obata, Gia Cam Luc, Éric Montésinos
series.synopsis:
Light Yagami is an ace student with great prospects—and he’s bored out of his mind. But all that changes when he finds the Death Note, a notebook dropped by a rogue Shinigami death god. Any human whose name is written in the notebook dies, and Light has vowed to use the power of the Death Note to rid the world of evil. But will Light succeed in his noble goal, or will the Death Note turn him into the very thing he fights against?

(Source: VIZ Media)

series.title: Descender
series.author: Jeff Lemire
series.synopsis: A robot child named TIM-21 wakes up a decade after a galaxy-wide purge of machines. His existence may hold the key to the Harvesters that destroyed entire worlds.

series.title: Dragon Ball
altTitles: ดราก้อนบอล
series.author: Akira Toriyama
series.synopsis:
Dragon Ball follows the adventures of Son Goku from his childhood through adulthood as he trains in martial arts and explores the world in search of the seven mystical orbs known as the Dragon Balls, which can summon a wish-granting dragon when gathered. Along his journey, Goku makes several friends and battles a wide variety of villains, many of whom also seek the Dragon Balls for their own desires. Along the way becoming the strongest warrior in the universe.

Part II of Dragon Ball is also known as "Dragon Ball Z" in North America.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

series.title: Locke & Key
series.author: Joe Hill
series.synopsis: After their father is murdered, the Locke children move into Keyhouse, a New England mansion where every door can be opened with a different key — and something evil wants them all.

series.title: Paper Girls
series.author: Brian K. Vaughan
series.synopsis: Four newspaper delivery girls are caught in a time war on the morning after Halloween in 1988. Their paper route becomes a journey across eras, futures and versions of themselves.

series.title: Solo Leveling
altTitles: 俺だけレベルアップな件
Ore dake Level Up na Ken
series.author: So-Ryeong Gi, Chu-Gong, Hyeon-Gun
series.synopsis:
In a world where awakened beings called “Hunters” must battle deadly monsters to protect humanity, Seong Jin-U, nicknamed “the weakest hunter of all mankind,” finds himself in a constant struggle for survival. One day, after a brutal encounter in an overpowered dungeon wipes out his party and threatens to end his life, a mysterious System chooses him as its sole player: Jin-U has been granted the rare opportunity to level up his abilities, possibly beyond any known limits. Follow Jin-U’s journey as he takes on ever-stronger enemies, both human and monster, to discover the secrets deep within the dungeons and the ultimate extent of his powers.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

series.title: Wind Breaker
series.author: Yong-Seok Jo
series.synopsis:
Jay's the perfect student. He's got straight As and he's the student body president. But after being coerced into joining the school's biking team, the Hummingbird Crew, he discovers a whole new world outside of studying. What new adventures will he face outside the comfort of his textbooks?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Notes:

- Includes two extra chapters.

- The work was cancelled after it was discovered that the artist had been tracing other people's art.

series.title: Bastard
series.author: Carnby Kim
series.synopsis:
High school life is hard enough, but it’s even harder for Seon Jin. A sickly disabled boy, Jin might as well be invisible. No one ever pays attention to him, except for the bullies who prey on him for being weak. Jin, however, keeps a very dark secret—there’s a serial killer in his house…and it’s his father!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

series.title: I Formed a MILF Party with the Heroes’ Mothers
altTitles: Betrayed by the Hero, I Formed a MILF Party with His Mom!
The Hero Took Everything from Me, So I Partied with the Hero's Mother!
